title: Schanuel's lemma
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $M$ an $R$-module. Let $0\to K\xrightarrow{c_1}P_1\xrightarrow{p_1}M\to0$ and $0\to L\xrightarrow{c_2}P_2\xrightarrow{p_2}M\to0$ be short exact sequences [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of $R$-modules with $P_1$ and $P_2$ projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then there is an isomorphism of $R$-modules $K\oplus P_2\cong L\oplus P_1$.
